notice: These are reviewed-design expectations, not assertions against the not-yet-implemented migration analyzer. Real HA runtime semantics require independent verification.

cases.title: No prior manual configuration

files.configuration.yaml:
homeassistant:
  name: Demo

cases.title: Simple include, explicit exposure and exclusion

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  project_id: example
  expose_by_default: false
  entity_config: !include ga_entities.yaml
files.ga_entities.yaml:
light.salon:
  expose: true
  name: Salon
switch.ancien:
  expose: false

cases.title: Inline map with custom name room and aliases

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  expose_by_default: false
  entity_config:
    light.bureau:
      expose: true
      name: Bureau pro
      room: Bureau
      aliases:
        - Éclairage travail

cases.title: Implicit default exposure when setting omitted

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  project_id: example
  entity_config:
    light.salon:
      name: Salon

cases.title: Domain-restricted implicit exposure and explicit exclusion

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  expose_by_default: true
  exposed_domains:
    - switch
    - light
  entity_config:
    switch.portal:
      expose: false

cases.title: exposed_domains ignored with default-deny

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  expose_by_default: false
  exposed_domains:
    - light
  entity_config:
    light.salon:
      expose: true
    light.placard:
      expose: false

cases.title: Malformed YAML cannot be partially trusted

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  expose_by_default: false
  entity_config: [broken

cases.title: Duplicate entity key in same YAML map

files.configuration.yaml:
google_assistant:
  expose_by_default: false
  entity_config:
    light.salon:
      expose: false
    light.salon:
      expose: true

cases.title: Whole Google Assistant block included

files.configuration.yaml: google_assistant: !include google_assistant.yaml
files.google_assistant.yaml:
project_id: example
expose_by_default: false
entity_config: !include ga_entities.yaml

files.configuration.yaml:
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages
files.packages/voice.yaml:

  expose_by_default: false
  entity_config:
    light.bureau:
      expose: true

  entity_config:
